name: Public - Website Chat (shared brain)
description: Website chat widget (floating box replacing the WhatsApp button): serves /webhook/chat-widget.js and the /webhook/site-chat API, answered by the shared WhatsApp+website customer brain.

parameters.query: SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('direction', direction, 'body', body) ORDER BY timestamp), '[]'::json) AS messages FROM (SELECT * FROM messages WHERE customer_phone = $1::text ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 40) m

WITH i AS (INSERT INTO messages (customer_phone, direction, body, message_type) VALUES ($1::text, 'Inbound', $2::text, 'web') RETURNING id) SELECT (SELECT id FROM i) AS id, (SELECT count(*) FROM messages WHERE customer_phone = $1::text AND direction = 'Inbound' AND timestamp > now() - interval '1 hour') AS recent

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ reply: 'وصلت رسائل كثيرة خلال وقت قصير. كلمنا على واتساب https://wa.me/97333444748 ونخدمك مباشرة.' }) }}
